news_risk: No adverse regulatory action or negative news found in accessible sources. Search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was unavailable during this check and ZaubaCorp/TheCompanyCheck returned HTTP 403, so Indian court/news coverage is partial: only Indian Kanoon was successfully queried. Court matters found are ordinary commercial arbitration and income-tax appeals, not enforcement or fraud actions.
rf_supply: No evidence found of supplies to Russia or CIS. No export records, customs entries or B-L data located; nothing public confirms or denies such shipments. Note: parent group Rexel SA (France) publicly exited/curtailed Russian operations after 2022, but no India-entity-specific Russia/CIS supply evidence was found in accessible sources.
note: Sanctions screening: OpenSanctions consolidated dataset (SDN, UN, EU, UK, BIS and others), data current as of 2026-11-26, returned 'No matching entities were found' for both 'Rexel India' and 'Rexel'. OFAC Sanctions List Search page was reachable but its results are rendered client-side and could not be queried directly, so OFAC/UN/EU/UK/BIS were covered only via the OpenSanctions mirror - a direct primary-list re-check is recommended. Court cases are income-tax and commercial-arbitration matters only; per project rules these are not rejection grounds and are recorded neutrally. Credit rating: null - no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings action found in accessible sources; not public in what could be retrieved. No negative news with dates could be verified because the search engine was down. No legal identity, HS code or shipment-volume research performed per role scope.
